newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose on Friday on the Beirut Stock exchange (BSE).
A shares rose to $113.5 from Thursday's $112, and B shares also rose to $113 from $112.25.
Turnover was 6,360 shares, up from Thursday's 5,200, and the value of traded shares was $711,612.5 from $577,357.875.
There was no trade in the shares of the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index was up 0.29 percent to 84.04 and the BLOM stock index was up 0.79 percent to 966.53.
